description: Assign sales accounts to territories from a ZIP Code prefix table you send. Send the territories, each with its ZIP prefixes (1 to 5 digits: 7 for a whole national area, 770 for a 3-digit area, 77002 for one ZIP Code), and the accounts with their US ZIP Codes. Each account goes to the territory with the longest prefix that matches its ZIP. Get back every account's territory and matched prefix, the accounts left unassigned, prefixes claimed by two territories (conflicts: those accounts are not assigned), nested prefixes across territories, and the count per territory. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/territory-assign-zip). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

account.description: Your account code or CRM record ID (up to 12 digits in a row; web addresses, card-length digit runs and dashed phone or Social Security shapes are refused). Not a person's name, email or bank account number.

zip.description: The account's US ZIP Code, 5 digits or ZIP+4 (only the first 5 digits are used).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'FY27 plan v2' (your own text, echoed).

territories.description: Territories and their ZIP prefixes (up to 100 territories).

prefixes.description: ZIP prefixes of this territory, 1 to 5 digits each (up to 200).

territory.description: Territory code, e.g. TX-HOUSTON or REP-07 (compared without regard to case, echoed as first sent).

name: territory_assign_zip
title: Territory Assignment by ZIP Prefix
